title: Keep the Quién soy cards rising into a spaced pile in reading order; the no-pile variant was rejected by the author
body: In `src/scripts/v2/intro.ts` the three skill cards rise into a SPACED pile (PILE, z in px, scaled down on phones) in reading order, Interfaz → Servidor → Entrega, and then turn to face the reader. Tried and rejected on 2026-10-28: a version with no pile, each card in its own slot from the start (the author prefers the pile); a first spacing of 260/80/-100 ('still too far apart'); and the earlier behaviour where the cards sat flush on one another and arrived 3 → 2 → 1.
not_derivable: intro.ts shows the pile, not that the no-pile variant and the wider spacing were tried and turned down by the author.

evidence.summary: PILE constant and the reading-order rise
Spike notes 2026-10-28: author review of the card stack.
